claimed_coverage: Tests that empty token.Type defaults to 'Bearer' when constructing the authorization header in gRPC metadata, as implemented by the setAuthMetadata helper function.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch adds setAuthMetadata(token *auth.Token, m map[string]string) which checks if token.Type is empty and substitutes internal.TokenTypeBearer ('Bearer') before constructing the authorization header.
issue_context_used: The issue.md describes that tokens with empty Type field should be interpreted as Bearer tokens when constructing gRPC request metadata.
notes: Hidden test file created at /artifacts/evaluation/tests/hidden_token_type_test.go. The eval.sh copies the auth module to a temp directory, adds the hidden test if TestGrpcCredentialsProvider_TokenType doesn't already exist, and runs the test. Test FAILS on buggy code (empty Type produces ' token') and PASSES on fixed code (empty Type defaults to 'Bearer token').
